payload.artist_html: Romain Vullo, Léo Galvão Carnier Fragoso, Jonathas S. Bittencourt, Adán Pérez-García, Imad Bouchemla and Madani Benyoucef
payload.description_html: Maps of the Laghouat Province (N Algeria) (a) and Minas Gerais State (SE Brazil) (b) showing the location of the ‘Garet El Hemmam’ and ‘Fazenda Tereza’ sites, respectively, and stratigraphic sections (c, d) showing the position of the fossil-bearing beds that have yielded the teeth of Lonchidionoides gen. nov.
